errors.truth: Retreat first (Oricorio Active by 0289), then Zone Lightning attached to Active Oricorio at about 0291; the Zone Lightning is still unattached at 0285 and 0287

errors.g: Retreat of the rainbow Mega Sharpedo ex discards 1 Water (2 to 1)
errors.truth: Mega Sharpedo ex has no retreat cost; nothing discarded, both Sharpedo show 2 Water

errors.g: Retreat of the regular Mega Sharpedo ex discards 1 Water (3 to 2)
errors.truth: No discard; the retreated Sharpedo keeps 3 Water, Active has 2 Water

errors.g: Retreat of the rainbow Mega Sharpedo ex discards 1 Water (2 to 1)
errors.truth: No discard; after the attach the rainbow Sharpedo has 3 Water, bench 3 Water, Active 3 Water

errors.item: Order, target state and time of the Lightning attach to Luxray
